name: websearch
description: Web search capabilities through HTTP GET requests

tools.name: web_search
tools.description:
Search the web using HTTP GET requests. Returns a list of search results with title, link, and snippet.

Supports:
- DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API (no API key required)
- Bing Search API
- Google Custom Search JSON API
- Any search API accessible via HTTP GET

If the host supports HTTP GET, this will perform real web searches. If not, it returns helpful instructions about enabling HTTP_GET capability.
